notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve sign-up (used free credits). Early discovery: team building chat + in-app help widget. Latency has become a blocker after initial pilot — customers report slow replies in EU and occasional spikes in NA during business hours. Key fragments from calls:
- "Feels fast most of the time but sometimes chat stalls for >1s; users notice that" (Product manager).
- Interested in Hosted API only (self-serve) but needs clear perf guidance before rolling to production.
Shorthand: want region guidance, timeouts, prompt sizing. Cost-sensitive: wants to keep token spend low.
Perf issues observed: higher p50 in us-east during 10-11am PST; p95 in eu-west occasionally 600-900ms. They used default model with max_tokens=1024 and full system prompt per turn.
Recommended quick wins (shared in call): enable streaming=true to reduce TTF (time-to-first-token), pick nearest region (us-west-2 for majority NA users; eu-west-1 for EU traffic) + route by GeoIP, enforce shorter system prompts (move static context into embeddings/doc-search), set client-side timeout to 25-30s and server-side request timeout to 60s for safe fallbacks, reduce max_tokens where possible, enable prefix/KV caching for repeated conversation starters. Also suggested use of a smaller low-latency model variant for interactive UI and fallback to larger model for long-form generation.
Customer quote: "If we can get median under 200ms in our core region we'll push to prod."
Notes on next materials to send: short "how-to" for region selection, sample SDK timeout snippets (JS/Python), trimmed prompt templates, and a perf test script to reproduce p95 spikes.
DoD for discovery -> qualified: successful 3-region POC with p95 < 400ms in target region and a token-cost estimate < $1k/mo at current traffic.
